attachment.pendingBody: This image is being checked before it can be shown.
attachment.blockedBody: This attachment cannot be shown safely.
attachment.retryFailed: The attachment could not be checked. Retry in a moment.
recovery.title: Picom recovered from a previous problem
recovery.uncleanBody: Picom may not have closed cleanly last time. Continue normally, or start with optional services paused.
recovery.crashBody: A previous renderer crash was detected. Your session is intact. Diagnostics stay redacted if you export logs.
recovery.footnote: Passwords, tokens, cookies, auth headers, and private secrets are redacted before export.
startup.title: Picom needs a restart
startup.body: Your current workspace view stopped unexpectedly. Your account data and signed-in session were not changed.
startup.guidanceBody: If the problem returns, open Safe Mode to pause optional desktop services, then export logs for support.
startup.recordSaved: A redacted recovery record was saved locally.
